newsitem.title: USA: Fed confirms Greenspan met with Costello.
newsitem.headline: Fed confirms Greenspan met with Costello.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Tuesday confirmed that Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan met with Australian Treasurer Peter Costello but declined comment on what was discussed at the meeting.
"Chairman Greenspan did meet with Peter Costello yesterday but I can't discuss what they discussed," said Bob Moore, a spokesman for the Fed.

"He (Greenspan) was very optimistic," The Australian Financial Review quoted Costello as saying after the meeting in Washington. "He indicated to me that he saw no threats to inflation down the track...I don't think there is any expectation at...the moment that (U.S.) rates are going to rise," Costello was quoted as saying.
Moore said he could neither confirm nor deny that statement.
